changes.comment: api-client-tiger, sdk-backend-tiger: Add Tiger types and guards for the absolute date filter with granularity and its dashboard filter context item. ITigerFilter and ITigerFilterContextItem now include them, isTigerFilter, isTigerFilters, isTigerFilterContextItem and isTigerFilterContextItems do not match them. The Tiger backend rejects such a filter with an invalid granularity or range, and lists skip the items that contain it.
